motifs.name: misty_layered_mountain_ridge
motifs.description: Isolate the continuous pale green and blue-gray background mountain range across the middle distance, including the rounded central hill, soft distant peaks, low ridgelines, and white mist gaps between slopes.
must_preserve: rounded green central hill contour lines
broken mist edges separating hill layers
small dark shrub dots along ridge crests

motifs.name: central_tree_grove

must_preserve: vertical ink strokes of thin trees
dense shrub dots at the base

must_preserve: brown thatch strokes along roof ridges

small red and green accents near the water edge

must_preserve: many separate oval lotus-pad ink shapes

subtle pale wash of the pond
